title: Updated Review.
text: Updated Review.. My original review was bad because I could not get them to work. With a little help from a friend.. the button on the back of the solar box worked and they now light up. However.. I did have to tap on the box a couple times and they flickered a bit the second night.. But now seem fine.Very small twinkle lights..
